subject: Tenant segregation proofing + KMS key rotation mapping for CAIQ
messages:
From: Samira Najjar <samira.najjar@peregrinehealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: security@peregrinehealth.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ ask: tenant segregation and KMS proofing

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. As we prepare the CAIQ submission for our vendor review, the audit team has two focused asks we want to confirm before we close the control narrative: 1) clear artifact showing tenant segregation across our control plane (network, storage, runtime) and where Redwood enforces isolation, and 2) evidence of your KMS key rotation/owner controls that map to CSA control CCMK-3 / K-2.

Would it be possible to share a short collateral package (diagram + timeline + runbook excerpt) and point us to any CAIQ control slices you recommend we include? We are on a tight timeline for our audit window next week.

Appreciate it —
Samira Najjar
Senior InfoSec Manager
Peregrine Health
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Najjar <samira.najjar@peregrinehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ ask: tenant segregation and KMS proofing

Hi Samira —

Thanks — we can definitely get this to you. Proposed package (short) I can deliver by EOD tomorrow:
- tenant-isolation-diagram.pdf (network and storage boundaries, tenant tagging flow)
- caiq-control-slice.csv (rows mapping CCM controls to our artifacts and owners)
- kms-key-rotation-runbook.md (redacted runbook excerpt + rotation schedule)

Quick notes: our isolation is enforced at three layers — tenancy tags in the control plane (request routing), namespace separation in the runtime, and per-tenant s3 prefixes with bucket policies for storage. For keys: production model weights and runtime secrets use CMKs in the customer region; we rotate CMKs annually with automated rotation plus emergency rotation playbook tied to HSM alerts.

Kimberly and Marissa — can you confirm owners and whether we should include an audit log extract or a screenshot of the KMS key policy page?

Sofia
Director, Security Ops
Redwood Inference

Marissa can provide the audit extract from the telemetry pipeline; I'll attach the policy snapshot.

Marissa — linking JIRA-SEC-876 where we've started the artifact collection. Also FYI, per the CAIQ mapping we call out CCMK-1/CCMK-3; I'll add the control mapping rows to the CSV.

—Kimberly
